decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.1%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold anyway, so no new positions were opened; existing 7 holdings are held unchanged to let stop-loss/profit-target rules do their job.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded in a narrow range today with no dominant catalyst, reflecting a wait-and-see mood among investors. Without a strong directional move in either the NASDAQ or S&P 500, there was little evidence of the broad institutional buying or selling that typically drives high-conviction trading decisions. Days like this are common and don't require action — they simply call for patience.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢窄幅震盪，NASDAQ及標普500均未見明顯方向，反映投資人普遍採取觀望態度。由於兩大指數皆無顯著漲跌，市場缺乏機構大舉進出的跡象，未能形成高把握度的交易訊號。這類平淡的交易日相當常見，重點在於耐心等待，而非勉強出手。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when markets show no strong upward momentum, so cautious investors hold back from adding new positions rather than chasing weak signals. It's not about fear — it's about waiting for clearer confirmation (like a strong volume surge or a decisive index move) before committing more capital.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險趨避」（Risk-Off）是指市場缺乏明顯上漲動能時，謹慎的投資人選擇按兵不動，不會為了訊號不足的機會而勉強加碼。這並非出於恐懼，而是等待更明確的確認訊號（例如成交量大增或指數出現決定性走勢）後才進場。
